entities.summary: Mykhailo Vasyliovych Drapatyi is a Ukrainian military officer who has been the Commander of the Joint Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine since 3 June 2025. He served as commander of the Ukrainian Ground Forces from 2024 to 2025.
